whenToUse: An online course or bootcamp with a lesson map, cohort calendar, pricing, curriculum and an enrol form.
Part-time programmes where pace (weeks per lesson) changes the schedule.
avoidWhen: A one-off event or conference — use site-event-01.
a11y: The lesson map announces the selected week through aria-live and respects motion-reduce.
Keep the enrol form validation messages next to their fields.
